body:
Most monsters only receive a single entry for both of their genders, but suidae and wildesau, though visually similar, remain distinct monsters by virtue of their talents in battle. Suidae, for example, are more nurturing of their young and the trainers with which they associate. They also have several abilities that make them better healers.
